title: VendPoint Placement Agreement — Removal Notice, Relocation and Model Swap
content:
Terms of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program for ending, moving or changing a placement.

**R1.** Removing a machine is the customer's own act by written notice.

**R2.** A machine with a removal notice is removed no earlier than the model's removal notice days, in calendar days, after the date the written removal notice is received.

**R3.** Count calendar days starting the day after the notice is received; the machine is removed on the last day of the notice period or a later date the notice names.

**R4.** On removal the stock is withdrawn at no charge, the final month's usage is billed, and the early removal fee applies under the program fee rules when removal falls before the end of the minimum term.

**R5.** A machine may be relocated only to another active ship-to of the same customer, scheduled within the model's relocation scheduling business days; a relocation or model swap does not restart the minimum term, and a swap to a different model makes the new model's parameters apply from the swap date.

### Evidence for R2

The date that starts the count is the date the written removal notice was received, as the machine's own record shows it, for the same machine being removed.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 30-day notice)

| Notice received | First counted day | Last day of the notice period | Removal on 30 March | Removal on 31 March |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 2 March | 31 March | Too early | Permitted |

A notice received on 1 March that names 15 April is removed on 15 April, a later date the notice names.

### Basis questions

**Does moving a machine restart its minimum term?** No; a relocation or model swap does not restart the minimum term.

**Which model's settings apply after a swap?** The new model's parameters, from the swap date.

**Can a machine move to a ship-to of another customer?** No; only to another active ship-to of the same customer.
